sections.text: Petticoat Lane Comedy Club brings you two of the stars of the Camden Fringe:
Kerfuffle is one of London’s top short form impro teams, serving generous dollops of fun from your suggestions.

A﻿dLibretto creates original musicals from the life and childhood dreams of a member of the audience. Tonight’s show will have an unusual twist, as it will incorporate some of the character of historic Petticoat Lane.

T﻿ickets are £10 (full price), £5 (concessions) or free to those who work or live within Tower Hamlets, thanks to the generous support of Toynbee Hall’s A People’s History of Petticoat Lane festival, which has been running throughout 2023.

links.text: A People’s History of Petticoat Lane

sections.text: This is the club’s debut in the Streets of Growth Theatre at Hayloft Point, site of the historic Boar’s Head Theatre.
